strings.I declare that the information provided: I declare that the information provided in this form is true, correct, and complete to the best of my knowledge. strings.If you leave anonymous usage tracking sw: If you leave anonymous usage tracking switched on, we record app session times and broad sections such as Program, Journal, Resources, Guides, Toolkit, or Home to help improve support and service coverage. strings.Messages to the real Juan, bug reports,: Messages to the real Juan, bug reports, feedback, appointment requests, and optional screenshots are sent only when you choose those features. strings.The Resilience Hub is a free, judgment-f: The Resilience Hub is a free, judgment-free space for everyday mental health and wellbeing support. Chat with AI guides who are here to listen any time, work through an optional 8-week plan at your own pace, journal privately, and reach for calming tools whenever you need them. It's a support tool — not a replacement for a doctor, psychologist, or emergency service.
strings.The app now uses your authenticated acco: The app now uses your authenticated account, Supabase access controls, HTTPS, encrypted database storage, and encrypted backups to protect account data. The former client-side privacy vault is being retired because a browser-data clear or lost device metadata could make encrypted records unrecoverable. We do not use your Journal PIN as an encryption key. Authorised service operations may technically access account data when needed to operate, support, secure, or maintain the service.
strings.The app uses Supabase authentication and: The app uses Supabase authentication and database services. Email/password and Google sign-in may be available. “Stay logged in” controls session persistence; disable it on shared devices. The optional Journal PIN is separate from your account login and can be changed or removed in Settings using your PIN or recovery answer. Do not reuse your account password as your recovery answer. Push notification bodies are kept generic and should not contain journal text, message content, or crisis disclosures.
strings.This is a peer-supported recovery and re: This is a peer-supported recovery and resilience program. It is not a substitute for medical treatment, psychological therapy, or detox. Participation includes honest communication about struggles and safety, regular check-ins, agreed appointments, daily journaling, relevant medical disclosure, and joint risk assessment for activities outside the program. Transport support is for agreed program-related purposes.
strings.When you ask an AI guide to reply, the r: When you ask an AI guide to reply, the relevant content is sent through our server to Google AI Studio so a response can be generated.
